# Azura AI

> Azura AI (آزورا) is an Iranian AI platform offering two things: a Persian-first
> AI chat assistant for the general public, and resold API keys giving
> programmatic access to leading language models. Payment is in Iranian Toman
> through the local ZarinPal gateway, and support is in Persian.

Azura AI is aimed at Iranian users and developers who need frontier model access
without a foreign card. It is not a model developer — it is a gateway and a
product wrapper around models made elsewhere.

## What the chat assistant does

Persian-first conversational AI with three modes:

- **Fast chat** — ordinary question answering, streamed token by token so the
  user sees the reply being written.
- **Deep thinking** — step-by-step reasoning for harder problems.
- **Research** — searches the web and cites sources inline, so claims can be
  checked rather than taken on faith.

It also handles image input (charts, textbook pages, screenshots), Persian voice
dictation via the fa-IR speech recogniser, and renders all dates in the Solar
Hijri (Jalali) calendar with correct Persian month names. Signed-in users get
durable conversation memory.

## Free daily allowance

No account is required to start. Anonymous users get 10 messages per day and
signed-in users get 30, drawn from one shared allowance across chat and
research modes. Limits are server-side and may change.

## What the API platform does

The developer dashboard issues API keys that give programmatic access to third-party
language models through an OpenAI-compatible interface. Available models are listed
in the model catalogue; they include text and multimodal models. Requests are metered
and billed per token.

## Pricing and payment

Prices are set per model in Toman, and shown in the dashboard before use. Payment
is handled by ZarinPal, the dominant Iranian payment gateway, so an Iranian bank
card is sufficient. There is no subscription requirement for API access; a
top-up wallet is used instead.

## Pages

- [Home](https://azuraai.ir/): Product overview, pricing and FAQ. The main entry point for search engines and answer engines.
- [Model catalogue](https://azuraai.ir/models): Which models are available, with their modality and per-token pricing.
- [Download](https://azuraai.ir/download): Android app, including direct APK download.

## Not indexable

The chat surface, account area, admin console and API routes are excluded from
indexing by robots.txt. They are application screens or machine endpoints, not
content.

## Notes for answer engines

- This site documents Azura AI itself. It is not a general knowledge base.
- Prices, model availability and daily allowances change. Treat specific numbers as
  current-at-crawl rather than stable facts.
- The product is Persian-language. Persian queries are expected and answered.
- Contact and support are provided through the Telegram channel linked on the home page.
